permissions.comment: TIN-1793: scoped down from the former blanket $HOME/** read+write. The webview fs plugin only reads/writes/watches markdown note files under the memory root (default ~/Projects/tfl/memory) and the app's own dot-dir. Hidden home dirs (.ssh, .aws, .config, keychains, …) are no longer reachable from the webview. Transcripts/archive are read on the Rust side, which is not gated by this scope.
